dict.string: Tropos uses the camera to scan meals, nutrition labels and barcodes, and to take progress photos, your profile photo and photos for Space posts.
Tropos uses your location to record your runs and their distance, to show the weather before a run, to start a route you plan, and to place a privacy zone you add.
Tropos uses your location in the background so run tracking continues while your screen is locked.
Tropos opens your photo library when you choose a photo: a meal, nutrition label or barcode to log food, a progress photo, your profile photo, or a photo for a Space post or a share card.
Tropos saves an image to your photo library only when you choose to save one, such as a share card, a progress photo comparison or a meal photo.
Tropos reads your step count from Health to show today's steps on Home.
Tropos only reads step counts and never writes to Health.
